core_claim.P: An attacker creates the launch token's pair via GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory before the launchpad does (front-running pair creation, e.g., before graduation or during bonding), so the pair is initialized with launchpadLp and launchpadFeeDistributor set to address(0).
core_claim.I: Launch token pairs created by the launchpad should accrue swap fees for distribution to launch token stakers; the pair must be created by the launchpad so launchpadFeeDistributor is set.
core_claim.V: The attacker-created pair has launchpadFeeDistributor == address(0), so no fees are accrued and stakers permanently lose their rewards, with no recovery mechanism to re-enable accrual.

distinct_impacts.description: Stakers of launch tokens permanently lose their rewards because the pair never accrues fees for distribution.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Stakers of launch tokens will permanently lose their rewards as the pair will never accrue fees for distribution.

distinct_impacts.description: No recovery mechanism exists to re-enable rewards accrual for affected pairs.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: There is no recovery mechanism to re-enable rewards accrual for affected pairs.

distinct_impacts.description: The issue can affect all launch tokens, not just a single instance.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This can affect all launch tokens, not just a single instance.

distinct_impacts.description: Token launchers (projects partnering with GTE) are indirectly affected because their token's staking rewards mechanism is broken.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: It indirectly affects token launchers (projects partnering with GTE) as their token's staking rewards mechanism is broken.

distinct_impacts.description: The launchpad silently adopts the attacker's existing pair when its own createPair call fails with PAIR_EXISTS.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: the launchpad silently adopts the attacker's pair

distinct_impacts.description: Swaps through the attacker-created pair yield launchpadFee0 = 0 and launchpadFee1 = 0 because launchpadFeeDistributor == address(0).
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: All swaps through this pair will have `launchpadFee0 = 0` and `launchpadFee1 = 0` because `launchpadFeeDistributor == address(0)`.
